# ============================================================
# FILE: tests/fixtures/sow_acme_website.txt
# ============================================================
STATEMENT OF WORK
Client: Acme Retail Co.
Freelancer: Jordan Ruiz, Independent Web Developer
Effective Date: 2026-01-15

1. SCOPE OF WORK
The Freelancer will design and develop a five (5) page marketing website
for Acme Retail Co., consisting of: Home, About, Products, Contact, and
Blog Index pages. The Freelancer will implement a responsive layout
tested on current versions of Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. The
Freelancer will integrate the site with the client's existing Mailchimp
account for newsletter signups. The Freelancer will provide up to two
(2) rounds of design revisions per page.

2. DELIVERABLES
- Fully coded, responsive website (HTML/CSS/JS) matching approved
  designs.
- One (1) contact form wired to the client's existing email address.
- Basic on-page SEO (title tags, meta descriptions) for the five pages
  listed in Section 1.

3. OUT OF SCOPE
The following are explicitly excluded from this engagement unless
covered by a separate written change order signed by both parties:
- Ongoing hosting, domain registration, or server maintenance.
- Custom e-commerce or shopping cart functionality of any kind.
- Copywriting or content creation for blog posts.
- Design or development of additional pages beyond the five (5) listed
  in Section 1.

4. BLOG FUNCTIONALITY
The Blog Index page will display post previews. The underlying content
management approach for adding new blog posts after launch is to be
determined based on the client's technical comfort level and will be
finalized during the build phase.

5. TIMELINE AND PAYMENT
Total project fee: $6,500, payable in three installments: 40% upon
signing, 30% at design approval, 30% at launch.


# ============================================================
# FILE: tests/fixtures/sow_globex_app.txt
# ============================================================
STATEMENT OF WORK
Client: Globex Logistics
Freelancer: Priya Nandan, Independent Software Consultant
Effective Date: 2026-02-01

1. SCOPE OF WORK
The Freelancer will build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) mobile app for
internal fleet tracking, targeting iOS only, using React Native. The
MVP will include: driver login, live GPS location submission, a
dispatcher dashboard showing driver locations on a map, and push
notifications for new route assignments.

2. DELIVERABLES
- iOS application submitted to Globex's internal TestFlight group.
- Dispatcher web dashboard (desktop browser only) showing a live map
  view of all active drivers.
- Basic role-based access: "driver" and "dispatcher" roles only.

3. OUT OF SCOPE
The following are explicitly excluded from this engagement:
- Android application development of any kind.
- Public App Store submission or App Store review handling.
- Offline mode or offline data synchronization.
- Integration with any third-party payroll or timesheet system.
- Any role beyond "driver" and "dispatcher" (e.g. admin, fleet owner).

4. NOTIFICATIONS
Push notification behavior for route reassignment mid-shift (i.e. after
a driver has already started a route) is not addressed by this
document and will be handled as needed during development, subject to
the Freelancer's judgment on feasibility within the existing timeline.

5. TIMELINE AND PAYMENT
Total project fee: $18,000, payable monthly across a 3-month build
period.


# ============================================================
# FILE: tests/fixtures/sow_nimbus_brand.txt
# ============================================================
STATEMENT OF WORK
Client: Nimbus Coffee Roasters
Freelancer: Sam Okafor, Independent Brand & Web Designer
Effective Date: 2026-03-10

1. SCOPE OF WORK
The Freelancer will produce a brand refresh package consisting of: an
updated logo (primary mark plus one alternate lockup), a one-page brand
style guide (colors, typography, logo usage), and a redesigned Shopify
storefront theme using Nimbus's existing Shopify plan.

2. DELIVERABLES
- Logo files in SVG and PNG formats (primary + one alternate lockup).
- One-page PDF brand style guide.
- Shopify theme customization applied to Nimbus's existing "Dawn" base
  theme, covering: homepage, product listing page, and product detail
  page templates.

3. OUT OF SCOPE
The following are explicitly excluded from this engagement:
- Packaging design for physical coffee bags or retail packaging.
- Photography or product photo shoots.
- Migration away from Shopify to any other e-commerce platform.
- Trademark search or trademark registration filings.

4. STYLE GUIDE SCOPE
The brand style guide will cover the logo, primary color palette, and
typography choices. Whether additional brand elements (such as
photography direction or social media templates) are included is left
open and may be discussed as the engagement progresses.

5. TIMELINE AND PAYMENT
Total project fee: $4,200, payable 50% upon signing and 50% upon
delivery of final files.
